visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length black hair wearing a dark grey sweater with white heart-shaped buttons stands in a brightly lit room with white walls, speaking to the camera and holding two makeup compacts. (2) A close-up reveals two circular silver compacts; one contains a bright bubblegum pink cream and the other a warm dusty rose cream. (3) The camera moves to an extreme close-up of the pink compact as a finger with manicured nails swatches the smooth, creamy texture. (4) Returning to a medium close-up, the woman applies the pink cream to her right cheek using her fingertips, smiling and observing the effect. (5) An extreme close-up focuses on the dusty rose compact as the finger swatches the darker cream. (6) The woman uses a fluffy makeup brush to apply the rose-colored cream to her left cheek while looking directly at the camera. (7) She poses by holding both compacts near her face, showing the difference in color between her two cheeks under the bright indoor lighting.
